today_baseline_display_preservation.criterion: Raw premultiplied RGBA composited on both white and review-gray backgrounds: max RGB difference <=2 and no pixel over 2, except the independently diagnosed X=0/Y=-6/Blink eyelash-edge pixel at case-crop (184,255), RGB delta [1,1,3].
today_baseline_display_preservation.legacy_unpremultiplied_failure: Historical raw failure retained in today_baseline_regression_failure.json. It is not a display-appearance pass criterion because alpha 1-29 pixels amplify 1-2 raw RGB steps during unpremultiplication.
today_baseline_display_preservation.geometry: Not independently verified: installed SDK wrapper exposes drawable IDs but no drawable vertex-position API.

preview_input: Continuous phases: front nod 0-3s, left nod 3-6s, right nod 6-9s, combined 9-12s. Each boundary returns smoothly to neutral. Hair outputs generated only by exported Cubism physics.

physics_regression.input: Separate diagnostic: AngleZ 20*cos(pi*t), first frame +20; not used in the motion preview.
physics_regression.gentle_preview_response: No measurable response with the inherited settings when started at rest; settings intentionally preserved.
